response.query:
PREFIX conference: <http://conference#>
PREFIX ekaw: <http://ekaw#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?invited_speaker WHERE { { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/ekaw/sparql> { ?invited_speaker a ekaw:Invited_Speaker . } } UNION { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/conference/sparql> { ?invited_speaker a conference:Invited_speaker . } } }
